title: Hinomori Shizuku — Butterflies Not To Forget〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This looks like a garden, but just how did I end up here?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, excuse me for intruding!
Is anyone there?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It seems not.
I'll need to find an exit myself...
se_walk_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
How strange.
It looks like I've ended up back where I started.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If only they'd put up signs to kindly show me the way...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, there's something over there.
se_walk_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow, this is amazing!
There's a painting of me on display...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, not a painting... This is a puzzle.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm wearing an outfit from Cheerful * Days, so is this merch from back then?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Ah, the frame...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wh-What should I do?!
The frame came off, and the puzzle...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But it was displayed so nicely...
Um... I suppose I should put it back together.
Could it be that you want someone to back you up?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Arisa?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I can't quite see behind the trees, but that's...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Um, Arisa... Do you know where we are?
If you happen to know who owns this garden—

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
I do know.
But hey, that puzzle has always been prone to falling apart.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
That's why I've been forced to put it back together so many times.
But I'm pretty sick of it at this point, so why don't you just do as you see fit?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
I mean exactly what I just said.
Put it back together, or don't.
And if you do put it back together, it doesn't need to be the same as before.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Well, this is all assuming...that you're capable of putting it back together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (There aren't too many pieces, so it doesn't look like a difficult puzzle...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
At any rate, I need to pick up the scattered pieces.
There's one here—

rows.Speaker: TV Producer
rows.Line:
Shizuku, excellent work!
Your aura was as brilliant as ever today! I can see why everyone admires you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (They admire me...?)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You look surprised. Did something happen?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No, nothing at all.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (There's another piece here...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We ended up going off-script today and I didn't know what to talk about... Thank you for always being there to help me.

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: You're welcome...? Seriously, when are you gonna learn to do things yourself? We're getting sick of having to play defense for you.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (There it is again, something from back then just suddenly... Could these puzzle pieces be...?)

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Shizuku, is it true that you're not gonna be in our next show...?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: You have the most fans out of all of us, Shizuku, and many of them were looking forward to seeing you during our next show.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: How do you think they're going to feel when they find out that you're not going to be there? They can't refund their tickets, you know?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I knew it... Every time I pick one of these up, something from back then pops into my mind.)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Well, this is all assuming...that you're capable of putting it back together.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Is this what Arisa was talking about?)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (It's true that a short while ago, I may have run away from the pain.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As I am now, I'm able to accept all of those past failings and regrets, all that pain.)

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line:
...
Why not throw away the pieces you don't need?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: That way, you can make an ideal you who never makes irresponsible comments or forces the people around her to give her backup, right?

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: As a bonus, all the trouble the rest of us went through because of a certain someone will disappear. All completely forgotten.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Arisa.
I don't want to forget.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: If I forget, I'll also end up tossing away the frustration and regret I feel over not fulfilling my role and carrying out my duties as the lead.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That's the one thing I never want to do.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Well, do as you see fit then.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, that's what I'll do.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... It's best to start from the corners and edges.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
It's finally done. Now to just put the frame back on the wall...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Great!
Now it's back the way it was!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
...!
Arisa?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (So, you kept watching to see if I managed to put it back together...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I still end up making mistakes sometimes, but I no longer allow myself to be entirely reliant on those around me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: As Shizuku Hinomori, member of MORE MORE JUMP!, I'm going to keep at my work with pride and confidence in the fact that I am an idol.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's have another appearance together someday.
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh...
It looks like I made it back.
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Shizuku♪
How was the fragment SEKAI?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Luka!
Um, what do you mean by “fragment SEKAI”...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean the place you just were.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I believe it showed up here because the feeling behind it resonated with you and the others' feelings that make up this SEKAI.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But with only a fragment of a feeling, a SEKAI can only maintain its form for a short while... So after a bit of time passes, you naturally end up back outside of it.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So that's how I made it back...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (A fragment of a feeling...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was quite a strange place...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: This beautiful garden had a puzzle with me on it, and Arisa was there...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's not every day you get to go to a SEKAI formed from a fragment of a feeling, so be sure to treasure everything you saw and felt.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I will.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I want to accept my past failures, regrets, everything... And make my future work all the better for it.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I think that's how I can take responsibility for my actions, and be different from how I was back then.)
